correctness.rationale: A completely specified forcing chronology proves Z<=(m-1)r. With d=ell-r, the consecutive-window matrix P has rank d by a triangular minor, C=PP^T supports exactly the within-arm r-neighbourhood, B supports exact cross-arm r-neighbourhoods, and h supports the centre edges. The resulting symmetric A has precisely the graph off-diagonal support. Branch profiles in ker(P^T) with sum zero produce (m-1)r independent kernel dimensions. The universal inequality M<=Z gives equality. Tested 83 exact matrix/forcing cases including 47 with r>=4, and independently excluded smaller forcing sets by enumeration in 30 small cases. These tests are corroborating only.

value.rationale: This solves the genuinely unproved higher-power regime r>=4 of a specifically stated contemporary open conjecture, for an infinite three-parameter family. It also supplies a transparent matrix realizing maximum nullity and hence an exact minimum-rank formula, rather than a numerical special case. The result cannot be obtained from monotonicity or the existing fixed-exponent formulas.
